generation.turnaroundSheet: codex-image (Codex CLI image_gen), 16:9 four-view product turnaround reference sheet on a pure white seamless background
generation.sheetCrop: scripts/turnaround_crop.mjs — gutter-detected crop into 4 single-view PNGs
generation.mesh: Higgsfield generate_3d, model multi_image_to_3d, 4 views role=image, should_texture=true, enable_pbr=true, should_remesh=true, topology=triangle, target_polycount=30000, symmetry_mode=auto, rigging/animation disabled

source.postProcessing: npx @gltf-transform/cli resize --width 1024 --height 1024; scripts/fit_glb.py per-axis fit (capped at 10% anisotropy), footprint centred and base placed at y=0
source.title: Oak open bookcase
source.description: Warm Japandi solid-oak open bookcase, five open compartments separated by four internal shelf boards, solid back panel, low recessed plinth base.
source.artDirection: Warm Japandi: solid oak with fine open grain, matte finish, gently chamfered edges; the plant in a matte stoneware pot.

requestedSizeCm.note: Rough target for the demo catalogue. The recorded widthCm/depthCm/heightCm above are measured from the GLB and take precedence.

measured.method: backend/api/glb.py measure(), read back from the fitted GLB

knownLimitations: No real product: geometry, texture and proportions come from an AI-generated turnaround sheet, not from a manufacturer's model or spec. matchType is generic_visual_proxy; do not present it as a specific purchasable item.
price_cents in the batch manifest is invented for the demo and has no vendor behind it.

The per-axis fit is capped at 10% anisotropy, so the mesh kept its generated proportions: measured 86.4 x 30.8 x 184.2 cm against a requested rough 90 x 35 x 180 cm. Depth is ~4.2 cm shallower and height ~4.2 cm taller than requested. The dimensions recorded here are the measured ones, read back from the GLB.

Verified by rendering the GLB in three.js: the five compartments are genuinely open and separated, with a visible back panel behind each — the shelves did not fuse. Shelf boards are slightly thicker and less crisp than the reference sheet.
Texture is a single baked PBR set at 1024 px; the fine open oak grain reads as a pale blond oak rather than the honey-caramel described in the prompt.
